test_df_rank: test the DataFrame.rank() method for computing ranks along rows or columns
test_series_rank: test the Series.rank() method for computing ranks with default average method
test_rank_methods: test DataFrame.rank() with tie-breaking methods average, min, max, first, and dense
test_rank_pct: test DataFrame.rank() with pct=True to compute percentage ranks
test_rank_na_option: test DataFrame.rank() with na_option top, bottom, and keep for NaN handling
